newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot propane lower in thin market.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot propane lower in thin market.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices were assessed lower in quiet late trade on Monday but talk was thin due to an industry wide event in the U.S. Gulf Coast.
Most traders were away from their offices on Monday, attending the annual LPG Charity golf tournament in Houston, Texas.
In Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane was valued about one cent lower to between 52.75 cents and 53.00 cents a gallon.
Conway, Kansas, hub material was a half cent lower at 55.75/56.00, players said.
Players were unsure what caused the decline, but noted weaker NYMEX crude and heating oil futures.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
